description: On the tabletop in front of you are a light green bowl on the right and several small toys near the center, including a green rectangular block, a small wooden figure, a teal square piece, and a soft blue item beside a white circular pad. The left hand reaches in from the left toward the green rectangular block, grasps it as a left-hand object, lifts it up and right, and lowers it into the bowl before releasing it, while the right hand stays nearby without touching anything.
